description: This file defines the PaymentTypeRepositoryWrapper class which provides methods to access and retrieve PaymentType entities from the data repository, including fetching all payment types, those with a code name, and finding a specific payment type with error handling for not found scenarios.

classes.name: PaymentTypeRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper service class that provides methods to access PaymentType entities with additional logic like exception handling when entities are not found.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all PaymentType entities ordered by position ascending.

methods.name: findAllWithCodeName
methods.description: Retrieves all PaymentType entities with a non-null code name, ordered by position ascending.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a PaymentType by its ID, throws PaymentTypeNotFoundException if not found.
